entities.name: Al-Majidiyyeh Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Al-Majidiyyeh Mosque is a mosque, located in Beirut, Lebanon. Originally a fort, the building was converted into a mosque in the mid-19th century and named after Sultan Abdul Majid. Damaged during the Lebanese Civil War, the mosque was restored in 2004.
